description: nhflow_2d_wall_dryland_a541 with the semi-implicit step (A 510 11, A 520 2, theta 0.5, dt 0.2 s): the column in front of the dry land stays in the coupled eta-phi system (nAct), its dry face carries no discharge, the slopes of its layer interfaces are one-sided. Without A 541 that column is hydrostatic and the wave at the land comes out at 0.56 of its height.
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::nh_prepare: nAct of a column next to dry cells (nhflow_drywall::cliff), one-sided NSX
